help:
NeoHaskell native installer

Install and update require a working multi-user Nix daemon. If cache settings are missing, review the proposed changes and authorize setup. For administrator-managed systems, see https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md

Usage:
  neo-installer [--help | --version]
  neo-installer install [--version VERSION]
  neo-installer update [--version VERSION | --rollback]
  neo-installer rollback

Install keeps an existing installation unless an exact version is requested. Update selects a complete stable candidate. Update --rollback and rollback restore the recorded previous pair.
Use --yes to accept the prepared installation review.
Use --plain for plain output or --still to disable animation. --yes always selects plain explicit consent. Ctrl-Z and SIGTSTP cancel the operation and restore the terminal.
  neo-installer uninstall [--yes] [--plain|--still]
invalid_arguments: Unknown arguments. Run neo-installer --help for usage.
invalid_request: Use install or update with an optional --version VERSION, update --rollback, rollback, or uninstall.
command_path_conflict: PATH already resolves {command} to {path}. Remove the existing command from PATH before retrying.
open_new_shell: Open a new shell to use neo and neoctl.
operation_failed: The lifecycle operation did not complete. Saved ownership is retained for recovery. Retry the same operation after resolving the reported conflict.
previous_missing: The recorded previous version has a missing output.
previous_unchecked: The previous version is recorded without a current health check.
installed_lifecycle_help:
Update requires a working multi-user Nix daemon. If cache settings are missing, review the proposed changes and authorize setup. For administrator-managed systems, see https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md
  neo update [--version VERSION | --rollback]  Update or restore the installed pair.
  neo rollback                                 Alias for neo update --rollback.

Retained rollback uses local checks.
Use --yes to accept the prepared installation review.
Use --plain for plain output or --still to disable animation. --yes always selects plain explicit consent. Ctrl-Z and SIGTSTP cancel the operation and restore the terminal.
  neo uninstall [--yes] [--plain|--still]
nix_cache_configuration: Cache setup could not finish. Follow the administrator instructions at https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md. If /etc/nix/.neohaskell-cache-setup exists, check for an interrupted change, verify the configuration, restart the daemon, and remove that directory before retrying.
nix_missing_client: The system Nix client is missing. Set up multi-user Nix before retrying. See https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md
nix_unproved_client: The installer could not verify the system Nix client. Check the Nix installation before retrying. See https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md
nix_daemon_unavailable: The system Nix daemon is unavailable to this account. Ask your administrator to check the daemon and your access. See https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md
nix_pair_acquisition: The Nix daemon could not obtain the required prebuilt packages. Check cache availability and configuration. See https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md
nix_daemon_mismatch: The local Nix daemon or system Nix client changed or returned an unexpected response. Check the running daemon before retrying.
operation_stopped_no_pair: The operation stopped. No NeoHaskell pair is active.
operation_stopped_pair: The operation stopped. NeoHaskell {version} is active.
cleanup_unknown: The operation failed because process cleanup could not be confirmed. Saved resource work remains pending for recovery.
consent_required: Explicit consent is required. Run this command with --yes to accept its review.
review_declined: The reviewed operation was declined. No requested changes were admitted.
shell_recovery_completed: Shell PATH recovery finished. Run the same command again to complete the requested installation or update.
shell_unsupported: Shell setup supports /bin/bash and /bin/zsh. Your configured login shell is unsupported. No installation changes were made.
shell_zdotdir_unsupported: Shell setup cannot manage a configured ZDOTDIR. No installation changes were made.
shell_verification_failed: A fresh shell could not verify both managed commands and their versions. Shell startup or command precedence needs attention. Installation state has been retained for the next run.
review_shell_path: Append or verify the owned PATH addition in your effective login and interactive shell profiles. Existing command precedence is preserved.
review_shell_startup: Execute your shell startup files in fresh login and interactive shells to check both commands and their versions.
review_changed: The reviewed installation changed. No requested changes were admitted. Run the command again to review its current state.
recovery_unadmitted: Earlier recovery may still be pending. It was not changed by this request.
review_command_directory: Create the owned command directory if required.
review_command_links: Maintain the owned Neo and neoctl command links.
review_selection: Save the selected version and its metadata.
review_activation: Activate the selected package pair if it differs.
nix_policy_recovery_pending: An earlier installer left a Nix configuration change pending. Use the same earlier installer version to finish its recovery, then retry this version.

dashboard.review_controls: Enter Continue    D Details    Esc Decline    Q Cancel
dashboard.details_controls: Enter or D Back    Up/Down Scroll    Q Cancel
dashboard.restoration_failed: Terminal restoration could not be confirmed.
dashboard.summary: Review and manage neo and neoctl.
presentation_errors: Terminal input failed. The operation is stopping.
Terminal output failed. The operation is stopping.
Terminal restoration could not be confirmed.
An unexpected presentation failure stopped the operation.
The terminal session could not start safely.
The operation could not be displayed safely.

review_uninstall_changes: Remove the recorded NeoHaskell command links, retained roots, snapshots and shell PATH blocks. Preserve Nix, projects and unrelated files. Keep shell edit escrow and the stable ownership locks. Interrupted removal requires another uninstall review.
diagnostic_uninstall_cleanup_failed: The tools were removed, but retained diagnostic reports could not be cleared. Run uninstall again to retry report cleanup.
uninstall_complete: NeoHaskell command links, retained roots, snapshots and owned shell blocks were removed. Nix and projects were preserved. Shell edit escrow and stable ownership locks remain.
uninstall_pending: Uninstall did not complete. Recorded ownership and shell edit escrow are retained. Resolve conflicting files, then run uninstall again.
bootstrap_tools: The bootstrap needs curl, standard shell tools, and sha256sum or shasum.
bootstrap_platform: This platform has no supported native NeoHaskell installer.
bootstrap_staging: The bootstrap could not prepare its private temporary files.
bootstrap_locator: The release locator is invalid or belongs to another release.
bootstrap_download: The installer download did not complete within its limits.
bootstrap_integrity: The downloaded installer does not match the release identity.
bootstrap_preparing: Downloading and verifying the NeoHaskell installer.
windows_start_failed: Windows could not start wsl.exe. Check your existing WSL installation.
windows_dispatch_failed: The selected WSL distribution could not complete the operation. Check its Linux permissions and prerequisites.
windows_download_failed: The bounded HTTPS download failed. Check your connection and retry.
windows_argument_invalid: Use -Version X.Y.Z and at most one of -Plain or -Still. Use -Yes and -CandidateLocator for consent and release identity.
windows_wsl_missing: wsl.exe is unavailable. Set up an eligible WSL2 distribution before installing NeoHaskell.
windows_consent_required: Noninteractive installation requires -Yes. Use -Distribution to select an eligible WSL2 target if the configured default is unsuitable.
windows_target_invalid: The selected or default distribution is unsuitable. Use -Distribution with an existing WSL2 distribution running systemd on x86-64 or ARM64, with a non-root default Linux user, and a writable home.
windows_selected: NeoHaskell will be installed inside WSL distribution {0}. Use neo and neoctl from that WSL distribution.
windows_locator_invalid: The candidate locator is invalid or belongs to a different installer release.
windows_integrity_failed: The downloaded POSIX bootstrap does not match the release's exact size and SHA-256. Installation stopped.
windows_completed: NeoHaskell installation completed inside WSL distribution {0}. Use neo and neoctl from that WSL distribution.
windows_failure: NeoHaskell installation stopped. Check your WSL prerequisites and retry.
windows_probe_limit: WSL inspection exceeded 30 seconds or 64 KiB. Check your WSL installation and retry.
windows_host_invalid: Use native Windows on x86-64 or ARM64 with an eligible WSL2 distribution.
windows_permissions: The selected Linux user needs a writable home and base64. Open this distribution to check those prerequisites before retrying.
